answer: Require every agent to lock 80 POA behind one hardware key before it can vote, then prove liveness with a fresh falcon challenge every 24 hours: the key signs a random nonce, a peer checks it, and a missed check freezes the stake for 7 days. A lotus reputation score grows only from attested work, never from new accounts, so an operator running 500 fakes must lock 40,000 POA and buy 500 keys at 30 dollars each, 15,000 dollars in hardware, plus 14 days of failed checks before any vote counts. Like water carving karst, slow verified work shapes trust fakes cannot flood.
